conclusion: A fixture's compiler comment and source templates do not constitute a pinned compiler or device-library build.
decision: Record toolchain and generated device-library identities before claiming reproducible HSACO emission.
invalidated_assumptions: A repository-tracked HSACO proves the locked LLVM and device-libs checkout emitted it.
observation: The fixture .comment names an external AMD clang/LLD build, while the locked LLVM device-libs lane contains source/templates without pinned generated bitcode.
question_or_symptom: A future compiler gate could accidentally mix an unpinned external toolchain with locked source claims.
